scope: Two identical generic ConfidentialWorkload declarations and a copied encrypted ConfidentialStorage disk on the existing dev SEV-SNP host, deployed through an isolated ArgoCD application.

identicalGuest.noCredentialOrResourceBeforePinnedTls: Enforced by TLS request construction and instrumented software tests; the live substitution test verified connection rejection.

startupFixes: Wait for authenticated installation of both Trustee policies before guest-local CDH requests; wait for all declared resources before encrypted application creation.
Keep storage refusals visible without restarting the measured helper; detailed errors require native owner authorization.
limits: First enrollment selects an approved instance; it does not prove intent before selection.
An owner who explicitly provisions the same volume key to another VM enables that VM to open the copied disk.
Trustee custody and the instance key are ephemeral. VM replacement requires explicit enrollment and reprovisioning.
LUKS-XTS does not provide general data integrity, rollback protection or a global singleton guarantee.
Kubernetes readiness is not an attested storage or application result. Infrastructure can deny availability.
Application ports retain their application protocol; application transport encryption is configured separately.
Targeted qualification is not an exhaustive security audit.
privacy: Raw attestation reports, chip identity, node addresses, image references, instance pins, credentials and key material are omitted. Private receipts remain with the owner.

argocd.scope: Isolated qualification application only; existing MEV and Trustee unchanged.
